payload.summary: Three SECURITY DEFINER functions omit pg_temp from search_path
payload.detail: schema.sql:3345 set_owner_id_from_auth_uid ('public','auth'), :5228 correct_clinical_query_terms (pg_catalog, extensions) and :5901 create_uploaded_document_with_ingestion_job (public). Without pg_temp listed, Postgres searches it implicitly for relations and types, so a caller who can create temp objects can shadow a referenced table inside a definer body. All three are revoked from public/anon/authenticated and granted only to service_role, which already bypasses RLS, so this is hardening rather than an escalation path - but every other definer in the file pins '' or ends with pg_temp; these three are the outliers. FIX: append pg_temp, or fully qualify and use ''.
